analysis:
Examined head lines 1-1046 of provider-swift/Sources/ProviderCore/ProviderLoop+ModelLoading.swift. Changes in these units: line 207 replaces autopilotAllowsModel with autopilotServesModel in the ensureModelLoaded admission guard. Lines 397 and 434 add transitionGenerations.begin(.modelLoading) and begin(.modelLoading, subject: modelId) markers. Outside these units, head 1148-1150 adds reconcileAutopilotPlacements() after slot removal on unload, and head 1298-1306 has further changes not shown here.

The weight-hash TOCTOU path (captureWeightHash 35-66, finalizeReusableSSDLoad 158-182, and lines 545-643) appears unchanged per the range map. It still fails closed: a reusable SSD load requires matching fresh pre- and post-load hashes, and a mismatch unloads the model. That keeps the verified weightHash binding in the T-041 mitigations and the T-012/T-027 weight-hash reporting intact.

The guard change only narrows or redefines which models Autopilot permits. It is availability and placement policy, not a confidentiality, attestation or authorization control. I can't assess whether autopilotServesModel is stricter or looser than autopilotAllowsModel because its definition is not supplied. Neither predicate affects the coordinator's per-model authorization or attestation (TB-011/A-016); both are provider-local load gating.

The transitionGenerations markers are bookkeeping. Their consumers, such as challenge or heartbeat reporting, are not visible. Integration should confirm that begin() has a matching end on every exit path, including the early throws at 411-427 and the catch path at 965-1017. A leaked generation could misreport transition state or cause DoS, but that is not shown here.

No security regression was identified in the visible changed lines.
